'''2008 Kashyyyk Regionals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship played on Saturday 19 July 2008 at That's Entertainment, 244 Park Ave, Worcester, Massachusetts, organized by [[Mike Gemme]].<ref name="sf-21295-307190">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307190#p307190 Official Kashyyyk Regional Thread], deck (Mike Gemme), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (12 June 2008).</ref> Its two byes into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]] went to [[Joe Giannetti|Joe Gianetti]] and [[Casey Anis]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Organization ==

Gemme posted the details on 12 June 2008: registration at 10:30 am, start at 11:30 am, and a $25 entry fee. He raised the fee to buy the full regional package, with its two World Championship byes, together with the six-uncut-sheet Special Edition package; some cash would also go to the top finishers.<ref name="sf-21295-307190" /> He wrote that he had placed the event in Worcester to encourage players from out of state.<ref name="sf-21295-307983">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307983#p307983 Official Kashyyyk Regional Thread], deck (Mike Gemme), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 June 2008).</ref>
